wizard.selectHint: Pick a discovered device and pair it.
wizard.noneFound: No devices found yet. Go back and scan again.
wizard.doneHint: {name} is paired. You can now connect it from the dashboard.

dashboard.emptyHint: Click "Add Device" to discover nearby Bluetooth audio devices.

device.detectedByClass: Detected by device class — pair to confirm audio support
device.pairedNoProfiles: Paired but no audio profiles found

events.title: Events
events.empty: No events yet. Connect a device and press buttons on it.

settings.title: App Settings
settings.scanDurationHint: How long to scan for discoverable Bluetooth audio devices (5–60).
settings.autoReconnectHint: Master switch for automatic reconnection. When off, no device reconnects; per-device control is in each device's settings.
settings.maxBackoffHint: Maximum delay between reconnection attempts with exponential backoff (60–3600).

deviceSettings.title: Device Settings
deviceSettings.a2dpHelp: Stereo high-quality audio for music and media playback.
deviceSettings.hfpHelp: Mono audio with microphone input. Use with Wyoming Satellite for voice assistant.
deviceSettings.idleHelpDefault: No action taken when audio stops. Whether the speaker sleeps depends on its own hardware idle timer.
deviceSettings.idleHelpPowerSave: Suspends the audio sink after the delay to release the A2DP transport. The speaker's own internal sleep timer determines when it actually powers down.
deviceSettings.idleHelpKeepAlive: Streams inaudible audio to prevent the speaker from auto-shutting down during silence.
deviceSettings.idleHelpAutoDisconnect: Fully disconnects the Bluetooth device after the specified idle timeout.
deviceSettings.mpdHelp: Route MPD audio output to this speaker. Add the HA MPD integration to create a media_player entity for TTS and media playback.
deviceSettings.hwVolumeHelp: Sets speaker hardware volume when MPD starts (1–100%). MPD then controls perceived loudness as a single volume knob. Default: 100%.
deviceSettings.mpdPortHelp: Port for this speaker's MPD instance (6600–6609). Auto-assigned on first enable.
deviceSettings.usePort: Use port {port} when adding the HA MPD integration.
deviceSettings.avrcpHelp: Track playback state and accept media-button commands from the speaker. Media buttons may or may not work reliably depending on hardware.
deviceSettings.avrcpUnsupported: Device does not support AVRCP media buttons.
deviceSettings.autoReconnectHelp: Automatically reconnect to this device on startup and after it drops. Requires the global Auto Reconnect master switch to be on.

adapters.title: Bluetooth Adapters
adapters.recommendationBody: Use a dedicated Bluetooth adapter that is not configured in Home Assistant and is not used for BLE scanning. Leave the adapter unconfigured in HA — this app will manage it directly.
adapters.onlyOne: Only one adapter can be active at a time. Select which Bluetooth adapter to use. Changing the adapter requires an app restart. All existing devices will be unpaired and need to be re-paired with the new adapter.
adapters.switchBody: You are about to switch to adapter {name}. Bluetooth pairings are tied to a specific adapter, so all current device pairings will be removed and devices will need to be re-paired on the new adapter.

forget.title: Forget Device
forget.message: Forget device {address}? This will unpair it.
